prompt: Write a CAML query command to get items from the 'Tickets' list where the Priority field equals 'High'. Store the CAML XML in a $query variable, then pass it to Get-PnPListItem.
hints: Define $query with a CAML <View> containing a <Where> clause.
Pass the query variable with Get-PnPListItem -List "Tickets" -Query $query.

validation.hintOnFail: Use Get-PnPListItem to retrieve list items.
Use the -Query parameter to pass your CAML query.
Your CAML query needs a <FieldRef> element to reference the Priority field.

explanation: CAML queries filter data on the server side, which is more efficient than downloading all items and filtering locally. The <Eq> operator checks for exact matches.

prompt: Write the command to add a new item to the 'Contacts' list with Title set to 'John Smith' and Email set to 'john@example.com'.
hints: Use Add-PnPListItem with the -List and -Values parameters.
The -Values parameter takes a hashtable: @{ Key = "Value" }.
Include both Title and Email in the hashtable.

validation.hintOnFail: Use -Values to provide field values as a hashtable.

explanation: Add-PnPListItem creates a new list item. The -Values hashtable maps field internal names to values. Use semicolons to separate entries on one line.

prompt: Write the command to update list item with ID 12 in the 'Contacts' list, changing the Email field to 'updated@example.com'.
hints: Use Set-PnPListItem to update existing items.
The -Identity parameter takes the item ID.
Pass the new values with -Values as a hashtable.
explanation: Set-PnPListItem modifies an existing item. Only the fields you include in -Values are updated; other fields remain unchanged.

prompt: Write the command to add the 'Task' content type to the 'Projects' list and make it the default content type.
hints: Specify the list with -List and the content type with -ContentType.
Use the -DefaultContentType switch to make it the default.

validation.hintOnFail: Add the -DefaultContentType switch to set it as the default.

explanation: Add-PnPContentTypeToList associates a site content type with a list. The -DefaultContentType switch ensures new items use this content type by default.
